dishes.make_ahead: Up to 5 days in a tin

steps.text: Mix the oats, flour, coconut and sugar in a bowl.
Melt the butter with the golden syrup, then stir in the bicarb dissolved in the boiling water.
Combine, roll into balls and flatten on lined trays.
Bake at 160C until golden.

dishes.n: Cairo market hummus and baba ganoush
dishes.make_ahead: Dips up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Char the eggplant over a flame until collapsed and blackened inside.
Blitz the drained chickpeas with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and iced water until silky.
Scoop out the eggplant flesh and mash with a little more tahini and lemon.
Warm the flatbreads and serve everything on a platter with dukkah, olives, sliced cucumber, paprika and olive oil.

dishes.n: Corned beef and onion hash with army biscuits
dishes.make_ahead: Boil the potatoes the day before to save time

steps.text: Boil the diced potatoes until just tender, then drain well.
Fry the onions in the oil and butter until golden.
Add the potatoes and corned beef, press down and cook, turning once, until crusty. Splash in the Worcestershire sauce.
Fry the eggs and serve on top with mustard and the biscuits.

veg.n: Potato, onion and baked bean hash with army biscuits (vegetarian)

steps.text: Boil the diced potatoes until just tender, then drain well.
Fry the onions in the oil and butter until golden.
Add the potatoes and cook, turning once, until crusty. Stir through the beans and sauce and heat through.
Fry the eggs and serve on top with mustard and the biscuits.

veg.make_ahead: Boil the potatoes the day before to save time

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead; syrup it while still warm

steps.text: Mix the semolina, coconut, 100g of the sugar, baking powder, yoghurt and melted butter to a thick batter and rest.
Press into a greased tin, cut into diamonds and press an almond into each.
Bake at 180C until golden.
Boil the remaining sugar, water and lemon juice into a syrup and cool a little.
Pour the syrup over the hot cake and rest, then serve with cream.
Boil the water and pour it over the tea bags in a large pot.
Steep for 5 minutes and stir in the condensed milk until dissolved.
Pour into mugs.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the beans the night before; the paste can be made 4 hours ahead and fried just before serving

ingredients.item: dried split fava beans, soaked overnight

steps.text: Drain the soaked beans and blitz with the onion, garlic, herbs, cumin, coriander and salt to a rough paste.
Rest the paste, then shape into 16 patties.
Shallow fry in 180C oil, 3 minutes a side, in two batches.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice, 1 crushed garlic clove and enough water to make a pourable sauce.
Warm the flatbreads and fill with ta'amiya, sliced tomato, pickles and tahini sauce.
